intro: Our Auraline almirah is where order meets durability. With it's sleek design, secure drawer, and steel strength with built in mirror, it's designed to deliver an efficient and sophisticated storage solution.

features.title: Built tough to protect your belongings
features.text: Made from cold-rolled steel, this almirah is durable enough to resist dents, scratches, and rust, ensuring your belongings stay safe for years to come.

features.title: Reflect your world effortlessly
features.text: The built-in mirror adds both style and convenience, making it easier to check your outfit while saving space and adding elegance to your almirah.

features.title: Spacious storage that keeps everything neat
features.text: Thoughtfully designed with shelves and a drawer, this almirah ensures your belongings are organised and easily accessible whenever you need them.

features.title: Secure storage for your valuables
features.text: A spacious drawer with a 4-digit lock makes it easy to store your valuables securely without worrying about lost keys.

name: Auraline Men Basic 2-Door Steel Almirah With Mirror Rocky Grey
